dedupe_keys.name: world council on city data wccd iso 37120 37122 and 37123 city indicator data and global cities registry

description: The World Council on City Data (WCCD) runs certification and a data portal for city indicators reported under the ISO 37120 series of international standards on city data. Its team led the development of the three standards published by the International Organization for Standardization: ISO 37120 on indicators for sustainable cities, ISO 37122 on indicators for smart cities and ISO 37123 on indicators for resilient cities. Coverage: member cities of any size worldwide that report data in conformity with these standards under the WCCD audit protocol, organised in 19 themes and listed in its Global Cities Registry; the list of certified cities and the themes' names were not read. Format and access: an open data portal (open.dataforcities.org) and a members' cities portal, both script-rendered pages that could not be read here, and WCCD certification for cities that join; the ISO standard texts themselves are published by ISO. Licence: not stated on the pages read. Caveats: indicators are self-reported by cities and then audited, coverage depends on which cities pay to certify, and neither the portal's contents nor its download terms could be checked. Simulation uses: comparable city-level indicators on services, infrastructure and resilience for benchmarking cities in capacity planning, social vulnerability and climate adaptation studies. Related records: none in the catalogue carry the ISO 37120 indicators directly; this record is the entry point for them (related ids left empty).
